A public Encoder is an option for a publicly reachable site. Install a private Encoder when you need:
features: Your own processing capacity: uploads use your queue instead of sharing a public service. Processing speed depends on your server and workload.
Control over your files: keep video conversion on infrastructure you control instead of sending files to a public service.

A site on a private network: a public Encoder cannot send finished videos back to a site reachable only inside your network, such as localhost or a home or office network. Your own Encoder must be able to reach the site.
Video library: uploads, channels, categories, playlists, search, comments, and user management.
Live broadcasts: live streaming, recording, restreaming to other platforms, and chat.

requirements.text: AVideo is a self-hosted video platform for publishing, managing, and monetizing on-demand videos and live broadcasts on your own infrastructure.
Payment-provider fees and infrastructure costs apply; configure prices and creator shares for your business model.
The included AI plugin uses a service paid with Marketplace credits; transcription and dubbing also require paid plugins.
Wait for the initial installation to finish, open and sign in as admin with your SYSTEMADMINPASSWORD.
S3/B2 is optional and requires a provider account and the corresponding storage plugin.
